$comment: Capability records for the Israeli B2B wholesale pilot. Each states what Odoo can do for a business, keyed to the requirement topics normalisation produces, and each carries the source evidence that supports it. A capability is draft until an AIOne functional reviewer confirms it against the pinned revision; a draft capability may inform a blueprint but cannot carry one to approval (Blueprint §8). AIOne delivers Odoo 19 Enterprise, so this set covers Enterprise modules as well as core, and every record states the edition its modules require.

verification.scope: The nine capability records that existed on 18 August 2026. Each statement, its modules, its activation route and its recorded limitations were reviewed against the pinned Odoo 19 revisions in catalogue/pinned-sources.json.
excluded: The two unresolved topics below. Verifying what the catalogue does contain says nothing about what it does not; approval.discounts (F-01) and approval.credit remain open questions requiring an answer about Enterprise modules outside the pilot set.

The residual gaps on inventory.traceability.expiry and finance.chart_of_accounts_israel. Both capabilities are verified as partial: the reviewer confirmed the statement and confirmed that the gap is real, which is why coverage stays partial and neither can produce a green assessment.
purchase.approval.request_workflow, authored from the Enterprise approvals evidence after this review. It is draft and awaits the same review.

description.he_IL: ניהול מלאי בכמה מחסנים, עם זמינות ותנועות לכל מחסן בנפרד.
description.en_US: Manage stock across several warehouses, with availability and moves per warehouse.

evidence: stock declares 17 security groups including group_adv_location (Manage Push and Pull inventory flows)
stock defines 51 models and ships 77 access rules
limitations: Routes between warehouses beyond the standard receipt and delivery flows need configuration review.

verification.note: Confirmed: multi-warehouse stock is standard in stock, activated by the multi-locations setting, and covers per-warehouse availability and moves. The limitation stands — inter-warehouse routes are a configuration decision per customer, not a property of the module.

description.he_IL: מעקב אחר פריטים לפי מספר סידורי מקבלה ועד אספקה, כולל הצגת המספר במסמכי משלוח.
description.en_US: Track items by serial number from receipt through delivery, including showing the number on delivery documents.

evidence: stock declares group_lot_on_delivery_slip (Display Serial & Lot Number in Delivery Slips)
limitations: Per-product configuration decides whether tracking is by serial, by lot, or none.

verification.note: Confirmed: serial tracking is standard, end to end from receipt to delivery, and the delivery-slip group is the correct surface for showing the number on the document. Tracking mode remains a per-product setting, as recorded.

description.he_IL: מעקב אחר פריטים לפי אצווה, מקבלה ועד אספקה.
description.en_US: Track items by lot from receipt through delivery.

evidence: stock declares lot and serial groups in security/stock_security.xml

verification.note: Confirmed: lot tracking is standard and shares the same activation setting as serial tracking. The two are separate capabilities because a customer asking for batches is not asking for unit-level serials.

description.he_IL: ניהול תאריכי תפוגה לאצוות ומניעת אספקה של פריטים שפג תוקפם.
description.en_US: Manage expiry dates on lots and prevent delivery of expired items.

evidence: stock exposes module_product_expiry as a configuration switch, which installs a further module
limitations: Blocking delivery of expired stock depends on the removal strategy and alert configuration; whether it is a hard block or a warning needs functional confirmation.
capabilities.residualGap: Whether expired stock is blocked or merely flagged is unconfirmed at this revision.

verification.note: Confirmed as partial. Expiry dates on lots are real, and the setting installs product_expiry. The gap is confirmed rather than closed: a customer who says expired stock must not ship is asking for a hard block, and that behaviour is not established at this revision. Coverage stays partial, so this capability cannot produce a green assessment.

description.he_IL: ניהול כמה חברות משפטיות במסד נתונים אחד, עם הפרדת רשומות ודיווח לכל חברה.
description.en_US: Run several legal companies in one database, with record separation and per-company reporting.

activation.evidence: base declares base.group_multi_company; company records are created as configuration

evidence: base declares 13 security groups including group_multi_company
stock and account both reference base.group_multi_company in their data
limitations: Intercompany flows and consolidated reporting are separate capabilities and are not covered by this record.

verification.note: Confirmed: several legal companies in one database with per-company record separation is standard. The limitation is deliberate — customers routinely mean intercompany invoicing when they say multi-company, and that is a different capability this record does not claim.

description.he_IL: מתן הנחה ברמת שורת הזמנה, מוגבל למשתמשים בעלי ההרשאה המתאימה.
description.en_US: Apply a discount at order-line level, restricted to users holding the discount permission.

evidence: sale declares group_discount_per_so_line (Discount on lines) in security/res_groups.xml
limitations: This controls who may enter a discount. It does not require anyone to approve one.

verification.note: Confirmed, and the limitation is the important half of this record: the group decides who may type a discount, not who must approve it. This capability must never be offered as an answer to a discount-approval requirement — that is the topic recorded as unresolved under F-01.

description.he_IL: נעילת הזמנות מאושרות כך שלא ניתן לשנותן ללא הרשאה.
description.en_US: Lock confirmed sales orders so they cannot be edited without permission.

evidence: sale declares group_auto_done_setting (Lock Confirmed Sales)

verification.note: Confirmed: confirmed orders can be locked against edit, released only by a user holding the group.

description.he_IL: לוח חשבונות ישראלי ודוחות מקומיים, כבסיס להנהלת חשבונות בישויות ישראליות.
description.en_US: Israeli chart of accounts and local reports, as the basis for accounting in Israeli entities.

activation.evidence: l10n_il extends account.chart.template; the template is applied at company setup

evidence: l10n_il defines no models and extends only account.chart.template
l10n_il_reports is the only other l10n_il module at this revision
l10n_il is core LGPL-3; l10n_il_reports is Enterprise OEEL-1, so the capability as a whole requires Enterprise
account declares 11 security groups and 125 access rules
limitations: The localization supplies a chart and reports. Invoice numbering rules, tax-authority submission formats and document layouts beyond these two modules are not covered.
The chart alone (l10n_il) is available in Community. The local reports require an Enterprise subscription.
Financial policy is unverified until an authorized finance owner confirms it.
capabilities.residualGap: Israeli reporting obligations beyond the chart and standard reports are unestablished and need finance review.

verification.note: Confirmed as partial, and the narrowness is the finding (F-02). The Israeli localization at this revision is a chart of accounts and reports — nothing more. An Israeli customer asking for accounting usually also means invoice numbering and tax-authority submission, none of which this record covers. Coverage stays partial, and per-customer financial policy still needs a finance owner's confirmation. The edition was corrected during this review from community to enterprise: l10n_il_reports is OEEL-1, so the capability cannot be delivered on Community even though the chart alone can.

description.he_IL: דרישת אישור להזמנות רכש מעל סכום מוגדר.
description.en_US: Require approval for purchase orders above a defined amount.

evidence: purchase declares group_purchase_manager and group_purchase_user in security/purchase_security.xml
purchase exposes double-validation configuration on res.config.settings
limitations: The threshold is a single amount per company. Multi-step or role-specific approval chains are not covered.

verification.note: Confirmed: purchase double validation is a real approval step above a single amount per company. The limitation matters in practice — a customer describing two approval tiers by role is beyond this capability and needs a further decision.

description.he_IL: אישור בקשת רכש על ידי מאשרים מוגדרים, עם מספר אישורים מזערי ואפשרות לאישור בסדר עוקב, ויצירת בקשות להצעת מחיר מתוך הבקשה המאושרת.
description.en_US: Approve a purchase request through a named set of approvers, with a minimum number of approvals and optional sequential approval, then create RFQs from the approved request.

activation.evidence: approval categories are configuration records on approval.category; approvals_purchase adds the 'purchase' approval type

evidence: approvals defines approval.category, approval.request, approval.approver, approval.category.approver and approval.product.line
approval.category declares approval_minimum (Minimum Approval) and approver_sequence (approvers approve one after the other) in models/approval_category.py
approvals declares group_approval_user (Officer: Approve all requests) and group_approval_manager in security/approval_security.xml
approvals_purchase adds approval_type 'purchase' (Create RFQ's) to approval.category and action_create_purchase_orders to approval.request
limitations: The approval happens on the request, before any RFQ exists. It is not a gate on an existing purchase order: approvals_purchase extends purchase.order only to log state changes into the request's chatter, and cancelling an approved request removes or flags the orders it created.
approvals depends on hr, so employee records are part of the deployment even where the customer wanted only purchasing.

unresolvedTopics.reason: No capability in the pilot module set requires an approval before a discounted quotation is confirmed. sale controls who may enter a discount, not who must approve one.

candidatesRequiringVerification.question: Can the Enterprise approvals framework gate confirmation of a sales order carrying a discount above a threshold, without custom development?
candidatesRequiringVerification.answer: No, not as the framework stands at this revision.
evidence: approvals contains no reference to sale.order anywhere in the module
approval.category is a request object of its own, not a generic approval applied to another model
The only bridges to a business document at this revision are approvals_purchase, approvals_purchase_stock and documents_approvals; there is no approvals_sale

unresolvedTopics.treatment: The Enterprise candidate is eliminated on source evidence: approvals cannot gate a sales order. What remains is a decision between an automation rule on sale.order, Studio, and custom development, and that decision belongs to an Odoo functional reviewer. Until it is made the fit assessment stays unresolved, because the treatment is unknown — not because the question was never asked.

unresolvedTopics.reason: Customer credit limits exist in account, but whether an approval is required before exceeding one is not established at this revision.

candidatesRequiringVerification.question: Does the credit-limit feature block or merely warn, and can blocking be gated by an approval?
